parsed.claim: For every countable discrete group G, the bespoke notion TracialGroupFactorEquiv is inhabited by the identity. This gives a concrete instance of the normal, trace-preserving *-isomorphism structure, so TracialGroupFactorsIsomorphic G G holds and the definition is not vacuous.

theorem probe_refl_factor_equiv (G : ConnesRigidity.CountableDiscreteGroup.{0}) :
    ConnesRigidity.TracialGroupFactorsIsomorphic G G := by
  refine ⟨{ toStarAlgEquiv := StarAlgEquiv.refl, normal := ?_, trace_preserving := fun x => rfl }⟩
  constructor
  · intro S p h
    first
    | simpa using h
    | (have h1 : ((StarAlgEquiv.refl : ConnesRigidity.GroupVonNeumannAlgebra G ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] ConnesRigidity.GroupVonNeumannAlgebra G)) '' S = S := Set.image_id S
       rw [h1]; exact h)
  · intro S p h
    first
    | simpa using h
    | (have h1 : ((StarAlgEquiv.refl : ConnesRigidity.GroupVonNeumannAlgebra G ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] ConnesRigidity.GroupVonNeumannAlgebra G).symm) '' S = S := Set.image_id S
       rw [h1]; exact h)
